judgment.rationale: The report describes a clear condition—Explorer Preview Pane enabled and a larger file still loading—when Ctrl+C fails to place the selected file on the clipboard. A commenter also reports the symptom goes away after closing PowerToys. The current build and file types need a maintainer-side reproduction.
evidence: The original issue reports PowerToys 0.75.1 on Windows 10 and says Ctrl+C does not work until the preview finishes loading.
A commenter reports repeated Ctrl+C attempts fail while PowerToys is open and copying works after closing PowerToys.
The report includes an image, but no reproduction across current versions or specific file type is recorded.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce using a large file with Preview Pane enabled and compare clipboard behavior with PowerToys running versus closed.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix is identified. The apparent association with PowerToys and Preview Pane is not sufficient to conclude whether focus, preview initialization, or file selection state is responsible.

proposed_fixes.title: Allow Explorer to copy the selected item while preview initialization is pending
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a PowerToys Preview Pane handler or related Explorer integration may delay or interfere with processing Ctrl+C while a large file's preview is loading, leaving the selected item unavailable to the clipboard. The issue does not establish the responsible component.
plan: On a current build, select a large file in Explorer with Preview Pane enabled and press Ctrl+C immediately while the preview is still loading.
Repeat with PowerToys running and closed, then with the PowerToys Preview Pane feature disabled if available.
Check Explorer selection and clipboard contents separately to identify whether the command is intercepted or the selection is lost.
If a PowerToys preview component is responsible, ensure preview work does not block Explorer's copy command and add a regression test using delayed preview initialization.
verification: Ctrl+C immediately after selection places the file on the clipboard before preview rendering completes.
The copied file can be pasted into another folder while preview loading continues.
Compare behavior with PowerToys running, closed, and Preview Pane features disabled.

confidence.rationale: The symptom and PowerToys correlation are concrete, but the old report does not identify the preview provider or which PowerToys component interferes.

issue_context.summary: With Explorer Preview Pane enabled, Ctrl+C reportedly fails for a selected file until its preview finishes loading; another user says copying works after closing PowerToys.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.75.1 installed through WinGet on Windows 10.
The issue is described for larger files and a delayed preview, but no file type or size is given.
A commenter reports the same broad failure in other copy workflows and says closing PowerToys restores copying.
There is one comment and no explicit current-version result.
inferences: A Preview Pane integration or Explorer interaction is plausible but unconfirmed.
The commenter’s symptom may be broader than the selected-file/preview-load sequence and may have a different trigger.
issue_context.analysis: The most direct test isolates whether Explorer's selected item can be copied before preview completion and whether the behavior changes when PowerToys is closed. Do not request generic logs before the failing component is narrowed down.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and comment and reviewed the attached image reference.
Inspected the current PowerToys Preview Handler ownership area; no evidence ties the reported clipboard timing to a confirmed code defect.

reproduce.version_requirement: Use a current supported PowerToys build; original report was 0.75.1.
prerequisites: A large file whose preview takes long enough to remain loading after selection.
A destination folder for checking paste.
steps: Select the large file in Explorer and immediately press Ctrl+C while the preview is still loading.
Paste into a different folder and confirm whether the file appears.
Repeat with PowerToys running, then closed; if possible, repeat with the PowerToys preview integration disabled.
reproduce.expected: The selected file is copied immediately, without waiting for the preview to finish loading.

actions.label: Approve clipboard timing investigation
actions.note: The responsible component has not been established; confidence is red.
